name: notify-mcp
description: Pluggable notification-delivery channel for care reminders over MCP (v1 records; real channels deferred).

tools.name: notify
tools.description: Deliver a care reminder through a notification channel. v1 ships a recording channel that captures the reminder without external delivery; the real channel (Discord/email/ntfy/SMS) is a later M7 decision behind the same channel seam. Returns the delivery receipt (deliveryId, delivered, channel) that the delivery-id dedupe store keys on for exactly-once.
